manualReview.method: Entire first source draft read and manually reviewed; one targeted source edit; entire final source read and manually reviewed. No implementation, dependency, port, or test execution.
findings: All five supplied import clauses, modules, identities and type-only bindings retained; public export names and signatures retained.

Exact exported initializer expressions retained: 200 * 1024; Math.floor((MCP_IMAGE_INLINE_BASE64_BYTES * 3) / 4); 2048. First two explicitly number, third remains inferred literal 2048. Compression request uses 2000.

New internal organization separates sequential projection, metadata index collection, recoverable screenshot backup, compression, generic artifact fallback, and pure presentation functions; no private predecessor decomposition was provided by the packet.

Preservation first computes shared-node context, explicit truthy preservation short-circuits structural scanner checks, and imported preserveOfficialCuaFrameResult receives exact ordered options and returns exact identity. Imported gate/scanner/constants and all dependency port implementations remain imported.

Authority hint requires non-array object, content array, truthy imported integrity metadata, native some with image and immediate-next string scanner acceptance. This structural hint is not cryptographic verification or an authority grant.
Compression-disabled path ignores screenshot metadata. Enabled path uses imported-key nullish fallback, native Set, numeric integer bounds and sequential native content array iteration.

Marked valid images attempt binary-only backup before inline sizing. Captured binary method uses original receiver; decoded empty bytes skip backup; decode and eligibility remain outside recoverable catch. Successful relative paths use imported resolve with one argument; absolute paths are retained.
Manual first review identified backup toolName should be explicitly captured outside its recoverable write attempt; targeted edit added that capture, then final entire source was reread.

Malformed or small images retain original identity; base64 payload size uses native UTF-8 Buffer.byteLength. Oversized compression uses original receiver, exact request and trace field order, ordered signal options, decoded nonempty bytes and exact prepared MIME/size acceptance.

Only backup and compression are recoverable catches. Each rethrows the same caught value iff current abortSignal.aborted is truthy. Successful returns are processed without an invented abort check. Generic write and imported scanner/gate exceptions propagate.

Backup suppresses duplicate generic artifacts and produces adjacent path notice after projection. Without backup, missing current store produces supplied omission text. Generic helper rereads current store at its write boundary, uses original binary or text method receiver, and keeps nullish path/URI labeling.

Binary/text request topology, own undefined trace fields, retention, extension mapping, current descriptor fields, Date timing, two-space JSON summary order, full original dataUrl and exact supplied output sentences/templates are retained.

Whole normalized official reference text blocks are removed by imported scanner; unchanged block identities and result identity persist when possible. Changed outputs shallow-spread current input.result, preserve nested metadata and structuredContent identities, and overwrite only content.

Native array some/entries, optional/nullish access, Set handling, shallow spread, Buffer base64 conversion, Date ISO conversion, node:path isAbsolute/resolve, JSON.stringify and exact size rounding idioms retained. No constant folding or substitute port implementations.
limitations: Manual contract-to-source review only; no compiler, type checker, lint, tests, runtime probes, dependency loading, integration validation or execution of authored TypeScript.

Behavioral equivalence and isolated declaration acceptance are manually assessed, not machine-proven. No actual frames, images, tools, providers, browsers, artifacts, media or user data were exercised.
Only file-byte accounting and output authoring/freeze shell operations ran; no business I/O, network, credential/configuration access, authority/access grant or dependency modification.
Instruction-only shared executor; there is no OS isolation proof or access audit. Mode 0444 is the requested file freeze, not an immutability guarantee against privileged changes.
No legal novelty, ownership, permission grant, license compatibility, MIT closure or clean-room conclusion asserted.
